title: The AI Agency Blueprint
tagline: Build an AI-powered local-business marketing agency from zero — pick a niche, craft an offer, run the ads, book the calls, close, deliver, and keep clients. One lesson at a time.
source_label: Re-sequenced from Owen Rensland's 20-hour AI Agency masterclass
footer_note: A self-paced course generated from Owen Rensland's public AI Agency course. Quotes are attributed to the speaker; scripts, prices, and code are illustrative reconstructions of the patterns described — adapt them to today's tools, and always follow platform terms and local laws.

0.name: Pre-flight: get your tools ready
0.blurb: Optional on-ramp: every account and tool the course uses, created and working, so Lesson 1 is spent learning, not fighting setup.

1.name: Foundations: the model & the mindset
1.blurb: What business you're really building, and the operating mindset that separates the people who make it from the 99% who quit.

2.name: Your market & your offer
2.blurb: Pick a niche you can dominate and build an offer so good that saying no feels irrational.

3.name: The operator's toolkit: fundamentals
3.blurb: The durable mental models — systems, science, metrics — so you can rebuild any tactic when it stops working.

4.name: Build your infrastructure
4.blurb: Stand up the software machine — CRM, funnel, video, ad account — that turns strangers into shown, paying jobs.

5.name: Meta Ads Mastery
5.blurb: The highest-value skill in the business: turning ad spend into booked appointments — how you get clients and what you deliver.

6.name: Get clients on a budget: outreach
6.blurb: Book sales appointments starting from $0 with cold SMS and cold calling.

7.name: Sales I: fundamentals & setting
7.blurb: Why people buy, and how to book appointments that actually show up.

8.name: Sales II: closing the deal
8.blurb: Run a high-ticket sales call end to end and collect payment on the call.

9.name: Deliver the result: fulfillment
9.blurb: Onboard a client and get their campaign live fast — natively — so they see results and feel looked-after.

10.name: Keep clients & scale
10.blurb: Turn one client into a compounding business, then scale past $30k/month on purpose.
